cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_sdl3_mesh_fixture C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
 message(FATAL_ERROR "This private fault-injection fixture requires Linux linker wrapping")
endif()
enable_testing()
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_REQUIRE_NATIVE ON CACHE BOOL "SDL mesh fixture" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
if(NOT TARGET test_sdl3_mesh)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "SDL mesh fixture requires the configured test font and Linux GNU/Clang linker wrapping")
endif()
